parameters.query: SELECT t.id, t.status, (t.organizer_user_id = u.id) AS is_owner, JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(JSON_ARRAY(t.logo_key, t.banner_key, (SELECT p.qr_key FROM tournament_payment_details p WHERE p.tournament_id = t.id)), '$', NULL) AS main_keys, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(d.file_key) FROM tournament_documents d WHERE d.tournament_id = t.id) AS doc_keys, (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_ARRAY(s.logo_key, s.banner_key)) FROM tournament_sponsors s WHERE s.tournament_id = t.id) AS sponsor_keys FROM app_users u JOIN tournaments t ON t.code = $2 WHERE u.phone = $1
DELETE t FROM tournaments t JOIN app_users u ON u.id = t.organizer_user_id WHERE t.id = $1 AND u.phone = $2 AND t.status = 'DRAFT'; SELECT ROW_COUNT() AS deleted
